items.title: Josh Jacobs: Taking part in practice Sunday

Jacobs (finger) is practicing Sunday, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: Could avoid limited snap count Sunday
items.description:
Evans (Achilles), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City, is expected to be active and is likely to avoid a strict "pitch count," though the 49ers plan to "be smart" with his workload, Jay Glazer reported on "Fox NFL Sunday."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Does individual work, but iffy for Week 12
items.description:
Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said that Jacobs (finger) did some individual work Saturday, but the running back will "have to show a lot of progress" over the next two days to be available Week 12 versus the Rams, Weston Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
